local.reason: First clone-A run (2026-10-19T21:00Z) used Homebrew's Node 26 for the website and built the website after the B2 gate had written website/public/data/benchmark-headline.json into the tree, so its website tree held 256 files instead of 255. Discarded before any comparison; the clone was retired and a new fresh clone (clone A) ran the corrected script (Node 20.20.2, publication builds before B2). Its steps are kept in local/discarded-attempt-1-clone-a/.

local.why: Clone A/B packages differed from Linux CI only in compiled DLL MVIDs and PDB ids: the CI runner image ships runtime 10.0.13, so its compiler host ran on 10.0.13 while the private SDK root had only 10.0.12 (local/compare-clone-a-ci-before-runtime-10.0.13.json). Runtime 10.0.13 was added to the private root and packages, metadata and website were rebuilt in two new fresh clones.

local.note: z3-release first ran with a pin-file parser bug in rq.sh (it read the size column as the asset name and reported MISSING); re-run with tools/z3rel.py: MATCH 7 of 7. Tier 2 exits 1 by registered design (30 known failures).

isolation: Every local lane ran with its own HOME, CALOR_HOME, DOTNET_CLI_HOME, NUGET_PACKAGES, npm and XDG caches under <scratch>/c25/iso/<lane> (tools/env.sh); ~/.calor was never read or written.
